name: Unwind Code
description: An AI + Web3 architecture lab building governed AI organisms: memory-bearing, approval-gated systems with public proof, sandboxed execution, Web3 simulation boundaries, and human authority.

defined_terms.name: AI organism
defined_terms.definition: A governed cognitive system with cortex, memory, gateway, specialized cells, safety boundaries, and a proof loop that can perceive, decide, act, remember, and improve under human authority.

defined_terms.name: Organisms vs apps
defined_terms.definition: Typical apps execute flows and often reset context; AI organisms carry state forward, route work through cells, pause at risk gates, preserve proof, and evolve through tested proposals under human authority.

defined_terms.name: Organism Stack
defined_terms.definition: The Unwind architecture model: Cortex for reasoning, Memory for continuity, Gateway for channels, Immune System for safety, Cells for specialization, and Proof Loop for inspectable trust.

defined_terms.name: Proof Loop
defined_terms.definition: The evidence layer that records tests, transmissions, review packets, release notes, architecture docs, status labels, and safety gates so autonomous-system progress remains inspectable.

defined_terms.name: Operating Doctrine
defined_terms.definition: The Unwind Code governance philosophy: money as armor, clarity before motion, human authority, proof before claims, replaceable cells, and Web3 simulation before live authority.

defined_terms.name: Money as armor
defined_terms.definition: A design principle that treats money as protection for human stability and agency rather than as the final authority of an autonomous system.

defined_terms.name: Intelligence that evolves
defined_terms.definition: The Unwind Code identity: AI systems that carry memory forward, improve through proof, keep cells replaceable, and remain bounded by human authority.

defined_terms.name: Culture-bearing intelligence
defined_terms.definition: A future Unwind Code research lane for AI organisms that preserve identity, creator economics, diaspora memory, and cultural context without flattening human meaning.

defined_terms.name: Transmission
defined_terms.definition: A public Unwind Code dispatch that turns architecture work, proof artifacts, safety boundaries, product signals, and organism research into inspectable writing.

safety_boundaries: Generated code runs in sandbox before trust.
Money movement requires proof and human approval.
Public posting requires reviewed publish packets.
Web3 work is simulation-first and no-broadcast by default.

operating_doctrine.product_constraint: Financial organisms protect attention, capital, and decision quality before any money motion.
Human-facing organisms should interrupt collapse patterns and clarify the next useful action.
Organisms must explain state, risk, assumptions, and authority before action.
Automation should expand human agency rather than replace judgment, care, or consent.
Cells, tools, providers, memory stores, and gateways stay swappable so self-evolution does not become lock-in.

engagement_modes.name: Architecture review
engagement_modes.best_for: Teams with a serious workflow, unclear autonomy boundary, or scattered AI experiments.
engagement_modes.deliverable: Organism map, risk boundary, first-cell plan, and proof checklist.
engagement_modes.proof_bar: The system can be explained as cortex, memory, gateway, cells, immune gate, and proof loop.
engagement_modes.authority_boundary: No tool authority until the architecture names what must stay human.

engagement_modes.name: Prototype organism
engagement_modes.best_for: Founders, creators, or operators who need a working organism path instead of another pitch deck.
engagement_modes.deliverable: A bounded prototype, reviewable outputs, handoff notes, and next proof questions.
engagement_modes.proof_bar: The prototype shows state, decision logic, output boundary, and what still requires approval.
engagement_modes.authority_boundary: Filesystem writes, public posting, spending, and Web3 motion stay off by default.

engagement_modes.name: Proof-loop audit
engagement_modes.best_for: AI products that sound powerful but do not yet show what exists, what is bounded, or what is unproven.
engagement_modes.deliverable: Evidence ledger, status labels, proof gaps, and safer public language.
engagement_modes.proof_bar: Every major claim points to an artifact, test, transmission, metric, or explicit unknown.
engagement_modes.authority_boundary: Private reasoning stays private; public proof only carries reviewed claims.

engagement_modes.name: Web3 simulation lane
engagement_modes.best_for: Protocols, funds, or operators exploring agentic Web3 workflows without hidden broadcast risk.
engagement_modes.deliverable: Read-only data map, simulation ledger, unsigned packet shape, and approval gate design.
engagement_modes.proof_bar: The lane proves no private keys, no hidden broadcast, no money motion by default.
engagement_modes.authority_boundary: Signing and broadcast remain human-controlled outside the organism.

engagement_modes.name: Product organism
engagement_modes.best_for: Teams ready to turn a validated organism path into a usable interface, workflow, or public product.
engagement_modes.deliverable: Product surface, organism loop, proof layer, launch packet, and iteration roadmap.
engagement_modes.proof_bar: Users can understand what it does, what it cannot do, and why the next action is safe.
engagement_modes.authority_boundary: Launch scope keeps high-risk autonomy behind explicit review and rollback paths.
